From: Aisha Hsieh <aisha.hs@finarc.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security walkthrough request — SOC 2 / DPA / Pen test kickoff

Hi Michael,

Hope you’re well. We’re getting the security intake spun up for FinArc’s upcoming evaluation of Redwood. Our audit team would like to schedule a combined walkthrough that covers:
- SOC 2 controls walk (45–60 min)
- DPA review + key contractual items (20–30 min)
- Pen-test kickoff (30–45 min) — vendor to be engaged, we want to align scope and evidence transfer

We’re aiming for a single 90–120 minute session or two split sessions depending on what works best for your team. Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Aug 21: 08:30–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 22: 15:00–17:00 PT

Note: our EMEA risk lead can only join after 11:00 ET on Wed, so if that matters we may need to split.

Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood will join (SE, CS, legal)? Also attaching our intake packet with the initial questions — that has a short vendor checklist which will inform the pen-test scope.

Attachment: FinArc-security-intake.pdf (2 pages)

Thanks,
Aisha Hsieh
Security Program Manager
FinArc
security@finarc.com

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Hsieh <aisha.hs@finarc.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough request — SOC 2 / DPA / Pen test kickoff

Hi Aisha — thanks for the packet and proposed windows. We can support both formats (single long session or split). To make the meeting actionable we usually do either:
- One 90–120 min consolidated session where we cover SOC2 + DPA + pen kickoff; or
- Two back-to-back slots (SOC2+DPA first, pen kickoff second) — that lets us route the right engineers into each pane.

Proposed from our side (PT):
- Tue Aug 21 08:30–10:00 PT (consolidated, earlier slot)
- Wed Aug 22 15:00–16:30 PT (if you prefer afternoon)

I’m looping in Camila (Customer Success) for evidence and handoff details and Ben (Sales Engineering) for the technical pen-scope.

A couple asks so the kickoff is efficient:
- Can you confirm the pen vendor you plan to use and whether they need direct access to a staging environment?
- If we do a single slot, please confirm which people must attend (execs vs eng).

I’ll hold the Tue morning slot tentatively until we lock.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
(m) 415-555-0198

If so we’ll plan to do SOC2+DPA first and then a separate 45-min pen kickoff later the same day (or next day) depending on vendor timing.

Appreciate the quick turn.
Aisha
